laws: While readiness blockers exist, package.json must remain 0.0.0, readiness rcSelectable must be false, and no readiness/finalization RC or v1.0.0 release coordinate may be declared.
When blockers are empty, BERS_V1_RC must be one exact accepted main SHA and finalization rcCoordinate must equal that readiness coordinate.
RC_SELECTED must keep package.json and packageVersionExpected at 0.0.0, releaseSha/releaseTag null, and releaseGenerated false until final affected release evidence closes.

Final release state requires package.json version 1.0.0, packageVersionExpected 1.0.0, releaseTag v1.0.0, releaseSha equal to the exact accepted release coordinate, and finalization rcCoordinate equal to the same readiness rcCoordinate.
A release-affecting fix after RC moves the coordinate to the new accepted main SHA and requires rerunning affected evidence before finalization.
